# Question fidelity and unique factors of open joining maps

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`joining-open-map-factor` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F22 · [record](joining-open-map-factor.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A map of joinings that keeps the joining and lifts occurrences role by role is an open map of the role frames and keeps every branching test of roles; two such maps from one joining factor through the pairs alike in their roles, the factor keeping the joining and unique at every fragment.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. For any two frames, a map of configurations is open where its graph is a bisimulation; it is open exactly where it keeps the claims, carries every step to a step, and lifts every step from an image to a step onto it. Under an open map each configuration is alike to its image, and likeness is kept and reflected. (`Becoming.OpenMap`, `Becoming.openMap_iff`, `Becoming.OpenMap.alike`, `Becoming.OpenMap.alike_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Read through roles, a joining's fragments and occurrences of joining are places: a fragment enters an occurrence by a role it holds there, and an occurrence is left by a role to the fragment holding it; nothing else is claimed. (`Becoming.Joining.Occurrence`, `Becoming.Joining.Incident`, `Becoming.Joining.roleFrame`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
3. For any two joinings, a map keeps the joining where fragments joined into one map to fragments joined into its image, and is an open map of joinings where it also lifts every occurrence holding the image of x in a role to one holding x in that role, mapped onto it role by role; exactly these maps keep the joining and read through roles as open maps of frames. (`Becoming.Joining.Keeps`, `Becoming.Joining.OpenMap`, `Becoming.Joining.placeMap`, `Becoming.Joining.openMap_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. Under any open map of joinings, every fragment is alike in its roles to its image and passes the same branching tests of roles, with no premise. (`Becoming.Joining.OpenMap.alike`, `Becoming.Joining.OpenMap.sameBranchingTests`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. For two open maps p and q from one joining L to joinings J and K, the map z ↦ (p z, q z) into the pairs of fragments alike in their roles, joined pair by pair, keeps L's joining and commutes with both maps, and every map into those pairs commuting with both agrees with it at every fragment; no finiteness and no decision is used. (`Becoming.Joining.Matched`, `Becoming.Joining.span`, `Becoming.Joining.factor`, `Becoming.Joining.universal_factor`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
6. With extensionality of functions as a named hypothesis, for two open maps from one joining, every function into the pairs alike in their roles that commutes with both maps is their factor. (`Becoming.Joining.factor_unique_of_ext`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Two maps p:L→J and q:L→K from the same L satisfy the explicit OpenMap condition.
- Uniqueness of the factor is stated at every fragment; as a function it takes extensionality of functions as a named hypothesis. No finiteness of the joinings is required.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The factor keeps the joining and commutes with both maps; that it is open or onto is not shown.
- No isomorphism of the whole and no unique provenance of a fragment follows from the factor.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

<a id="history--沿革"></a>
### History

- 2026-10-08: continued the existing joining-context study, with distinct scopes for common refinement, compatible factors, real information loss and retained-reference repair.
- 2026-10-09: reuse this result in finite-granularity continuation; preserve its claim, hypotheses and proof bindings. New prefix omission and resumption testing appear in the same study §§22–26.
- 2026-10-09 continuation: finite guarded programs, residual recovery and 35 checked declarations added in the same study §§27–32; this result retains its claim, assumptions and proof bindings.
- 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): restated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Open maps of joinings are the open maps of the role frames (Joining.openMap_iff; in the bridge openMap_iff_incidence) and keep likeness and every role test (OpenMap.alike, Joining.OpenMap.sameBranchingTests, openMap_keeps_role_tests); two open maps from one joining factor through it, the factor unique at every fragment (Joining.universal_factor). It differs from the periphery: uniqueness is pointwise, since equality of functions needs funext, and the factor maps into alike pairs rather than equally answering ones. The periphery's incidence step, sameness of answers and span are defined through a match with an overlapping wildcard case (the register study's step through xs[i]?), and their compiled definitions use propext, so no statement mentioning them has an empty axiom report; the claim is therefore restated on the core's role frame (Joining.roleFrame) or retained frame (Joining.retainedFrame), not as a literal instance, the bridge showing that the periphery's open maps and local finiteness are the core's (openMap_iff_incidence, locallyFinite_iff). The periphery's every_exact_account_has_canonical_factor needs funext and propext and stays there. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing).
